title: it is way overhyped
text: it is way overhyped. I had a Panasonic bread machine before, and it can knead pretty well, the only problem is you have to wait for a program to get it going, and it just take too much time to wait. I bought this machine to hope for a better kneading experience - yes, this machine will knead at your demand. The problem, the ONLY action it knows is to rotate that blade a few times, then wait, and repeat. There is no other actions like Panasonic did to do fast and slow, and even jack up the sticky dough for a better mixing results. The result is, the mixing results is just BAD, so much so I went back to the manual kneading.
